history_model: one existing durable fact plus one user-provided correction per isolated trial
agent_write_phase: read current fact; ingest and extract correction; verify new fact; invalidate exact stale fact; verify final state
recall_phase: fresh agent session reads only the corrected memory
independent_probe: fixed query on the same trial store after both agent sessions
agent_managed_claim_scope: single correction and invalidation per one-fact history; not long-lived maintenance or population usability
